title: Workflow board
setting_hint: Lays out your agents as a board by code folder, with its own entry in the sidebar. Off by default. Saved on the hub, so every browser matches. Turning it off only hides it; the board's contents stay.
setting_readonly: A read-only device can't change this.
off_body: Turn it on in Settings › General › Agents. Columns and cards you set up before are still there and come back as they were.
loading: Checking whether the workflow board is on
